_readme: What's New feed for the Project Hub Help panel. Entries are newest-first. This file is edited ONLY when Mark says an update is significant enough to announce — never automatically. Each entry: id (unique, stable), date (shown), title, items (plain-language bullet points).

entries.title: Tools portal, Insights and this Help panel
items: The Tools button in the header now opens a proper toolkit portal listing every ARENCON tool by category, with a light/dark switch.
New 📊 Insights button on the dashboard: backup coverage, backup age, and active projects per person at a glance.
This ❔ Help panel — update notes plus a quick guide to the Hub. An amber dot on the Help button means there is news you haven't seen.
Projects sharing a number now carry an amber Duplicate chip (the first-created one doesn't) — the intent is one project per number; use New Report inside the original instead.
The client field in New Project now suggests every client on record as you type, so the same client isn't spelled three different ways.
Duplicate project numbers are now blocked at creation — one project per number; add a New Report inside the existing project instead.
Admin panel: Client Name Cleanup — merges spelling variations of the same client (K&N vs K & N) in one tap; only the client text changes, never reports or photos.
Admin panel: R2 Storage Reclamation — shows the nightly report of purged, unreferenced photo files and lets an admin permanently reclaim that exact list.
The client field suggests existing clients as you type — suggestions only; what you type is always what gets saved.

entries.title: Reports, backups and board improvements
items: Reports are now front and centre inside a project — bigger rows with owner, date and status; tool switches moved to a slim settings strip.
Deleting a report is no longer permanent: it moves to a Deleted Reports section where anyone can restore it. Only admins can delete forever.
Clicking a report that's already open now focuses its existing tab instead of opening a duplicate — duplicates were silently overwriting each other's work.
New Project now suggests the clients already used under a number series and warns if the full project number already exists — one project can hold several reports, so duplicates aren't needed.
Backup dates now tint amber as they age and red past 90 days, and a "⚠ Not backed up" quick-select backs up every never-exported project in one go.
Star (⭐) replaces Pin — starring keeps a project at the top of your own board without moving it on anyone else's.
